citation_meaning.rationale: The excerpt contains no citation keys or attributed evidence links to relocate.

reference_claim_alignment.rationale: The excerpt contains no figure/table/equation identifiers.

technical_meaning.rationale: Reproducibility, longitudinal data, methods and computing environments are unchanged.
